propositions: Three nearly-identical exclusive lock acquisition and release loops exist across enrich_drain.py, compact_trigger.py, and gc_trigger.py using os.O_CREAT|O_EXCL and stamped_file_is_stale.

Release semantics differ: enrich_drain wraps close and unlink in one try block causing lock file leak on close failure, while compact_trigger and gc_trigger use two independent try blocks ensuring unlink always runs.

The three implementations have minor but material differences in stamp bytes (drain appends newline), logging behavior (drain names lock holder and warns on stamp failure), and directory creation strategies that must be reconciled or isolated.

A shared stamped_lock.py helper module must extract the acquire-reclaim-release pattern while preserving the drain's holder naming capability, stamp-failure WARNING for all three workers, and the two-try release form as a behavior fix.
